The morning counted the pieces that moved twice. Half of the sanding backlog was not sanding, it was work sitting in the aisle between the two cells, waiting for a free staging place. What we do not do
We do not give new joiners a laptop on their first day without a configuration check.

answer: Error ERR-6083 occurs when an invoice line carries no cost centre, causing the sync to refuse the whole document [1].
sources:
When a document is refused
Error ERR-6083 appears when an invoice line carries no cost centre and the sync refuses the whole document.
The document stays in the project folder with a note in the log, and the milestone is not invoiced. Do not send the client a reminder for an invoice that has not been raised.

The nightly run
The sync reads the project folder, matches each document to a project record, and writes one finance document per invoice. It runs at two in the morning and it is safe to run again on the same day: documents that were already copied are skipped.
A document with no project number is not copied.
A document with no cost centre is not copied.
A document with no customer reference is h…

Common mistakes
Editing an invoice after the sync has run, which leaves two versions in the folder.
Giving a milestone a different percentage from the contract to make a number balance.
Moving a document between project folders after it has been copied.
Treating a held document as a refused one, and chasing the client for it.

When the node refuses to join
Error ERR-4712 means the node refused to join the pool because its key does not match the signed one.
The fix is short and it must be done in this order.
Read the serial plate and write the last four characters down.
Compare them with the last four characters of the key on the printed sheet.
If they differ, the wrong sheet was printed: get a new sheet from the worksh…

Out of hours
The workshop is empty outside core hours, and the rules change in two ways: the extractor is switched off and the sanding line is locked. The extraction rule is the one exception that is allowed, because running a filtered line all night costs more than it saves.

answer: The team leader validates the newcomer's training log, which is the only thing that proves the first week happened [1].
sources:
The first week
Every new joiner spends their first week with a buddy from the workshop and keeps a training log signed off by their team lead.
The buddy is not a mentor and not a teacher. The buddy shows where things are, how the machine works and where the coffee is. The training log is a list of tasks with a date and a signature, and it is the only thing that proves the first week happened.

What the buddy does not do
The buddy does not check the work, does not assess the person and does not report on the first week to the team leader. The buddy answers questions, shows where things are and says out loud when something is not obvious. A team leader who wants to know how the first week went reads the training log and asks the person.

Before the first day
The people team sends a short welcome pack on the Thursday before a start date. It contains the building map, the wifi instructions, the first week's plan and the name of the buddy. Nothing in it is long, because nobody reads anything long in their first week.
A start date is only confirmed once the following three things are true.
The contract is signed and the payroll recor…

What the quarter looks like
Eight opportunities, one workshop and a paint line that is booked until September. The quarter is not short of work, it is short of capacity, and the first job of the sales team is to stop offering work the workshop cannot take. Ana opens every discovery call with the capacity list on the table, which is why two enquiries went to competitors in January without anybody …

What people will do differently
Ana writes a one-page brief before every discovery call.
Chloe reviews the drawings of every healthcare proposal, because infection control is where we lose work.
Ben publishes the capacity list every Monday morning.
The account managers send the client a programme, not a price, when a request is vague.

answer: Everyone has twenty-eight days of paid annual leave a year [1].
sources:
Annual leave
Everyone has twenty-eight days of paid annual leave a year, plus the public holidays between Christmas and New Year, which are not counted. Nobody is expected to take more than twenty-eight days and nobody is asked to explain why they took fewer.
Annual leave must be booked in the people system before the first day of the requested month, and no more than twenty-five consecutive days…

Sick leave
Sick leave is paid in full for the first fourteen days and at half rate for the next fourteen. It is booked the same morning, by message, with no certificate below three days and a certificate from day four.
Unplanned absence is not annual leave and is handled by the team leader the same morning.

Special leave
Care for a sick child: up to ten days a year, no reason required.
A family event: three days, used once.
Study leave: five days a year for a course the team leader agrees to.
Unpaid leave: by arrangement with the people team, in writing, with an end date.

What changes for people
From June, everyone gets two days a year of paid volunteering, booked like leave.
The canteen moves to a later start during the summer months, from 7:30 to 8:00.
Everyone in the workshop gets a hearing check every second year, paid by the company.
The catalogue in French is printed once a year, in March, and not on demand.

How a remote day is agreed
The days spent working from home are booked a week ahead in the people system, and the plan is visible to the whole team.
Bookings are made in the same system as leave, because a remote day and a leave day compete for the same person on the same day. There is no separate tool and no separate rule.
A request is made before Wednesday for the following week.

answer: The dust extractor must run before a spindle sander is switched on and must run continuously whenever a spindle sander is operating [2]. It must also run before the machine starts, never after [2].
sources:
Dust and extraction
Extraction is the reason the paint line is being rebuilt, and the sanding backlog is eleven weeks long because the extraction specification was wrong for our varnish. The rules are not superstition.
Every machine that produces dust is connected to a filtered extraction.
Filters are replaced on the schedule, not when the reading drops.
The filter readings are written on the she…

The rules that are not negotiable
The workshop runs on three rules. They are short, they are posted at every machine, and nobody is allowed to make an exception, including the foreman.
Hearing protection is compulsory on the sanding line, and the dust extractor must run whenever a spindle sander is switched on.
The extractor runs before the machine starts, never after.
A machine with a broken gua…

Out of hours
The workshop is empty outside core hours, and the rules change in two ways: the extractor is switched off and the sanding line is locked. The extraction rule is the one exception that is allowed, because running a filtered line all night costs more than it saves.

The twenty-minute soak test
The soak test is not a formality. The lights run at full, the blinds close, and the room is left alone. Two things only show up in that window: a sensor that has drifted and a power supply that is close to its limit. If the room survives twenty minutes with the blinds closed, it will survive a normal evening.

The three findings
Goods-in and the finishing cell compete for the same aisle, so half-finished work sits in the traffic.
The extraction filter on the paint line was replaced twice in a year, which means the filter specification is wrong for the varnish we use.
Two products, the wall shelf and the small side table, wait eleven days for a finishing step that takes four hours.

sources:
When the node refuses to join
Error ERR-4712 means the node refused to join the pool because its key does not match the signed one.
The fix is short and it must be done in this order.
Read the serial plate and write the last four characters down.
Compare them with the last four characters of the key on the printed sheet.
If they differ, the wrong sheet was printed: get a new sheet from the worksh…

When a document is refused
Error ERR-6083 appears when an invoice line carries no cost centre and the sync refuses the whole document.
The document stays in the project folder with a note in the log, and the milestone is not invoiced. Do not send the client a reminder for an invoice that has not been raised.

If the soak test fails
A scene that does not trigger usually means a sensor is paired to the wrong room.
A panel that resets means the power supply is underloaded; check what else is on the circuit.
A node that works but is not visible on the network is a network issue, not a node issue, and the node should not be replaced.

Les questions de l'architecte
Elle a demandé par écrit, avant la réunion, la composition exacte du contreplaqué de nos caissons, l'épaisseur des chants et la tolérance de planéité du support. Nous avons répondu avec la fiche technique du système Rive Nord et le cahier des charges.
Elle a aussi demandé ce qui se passait si le sol n'était pas plan. La réponse a été claire : nous relevons le sol à l…

Ce que nous ne faisons pas
Nous ne livrons pas de système autoporté pour les grandes largeurs.
Nous ne posons pas sur un sol dont le relevé n'a pas été fait.
Nous ne garantissons pas la planéité d'un mur ancien ; le mur est relevé au même titre que le sol.

answer: Four weeks without a written request from inside the client [2].
sources:
How a deal enters the forecast
An opportunity enters the forecast when there is a written request from inside the client, and it leaves the forecast when four weeks pass without one. The stage is updated by the person who owns the relationship, in the weekly review, with the reason in the notes. A stage that nobody can explain is a stage that does not exist.

How we use it
The workshop manager reads the negotiation and proposal rows only.
The monthly review looks at days since the last written contact, not at the value.
Any row with no written request from inside the client for four weeks is removed from the forecast until there is one.
The Lyon studio reads the forecast to plan its own capacity in French-speaking accounts.

What the forecast is not
It is not a commitment and it is not a target for the workshop. The workshop plans on the signed value and the confirmed start dates, nothing else. In 2025 the forecast was eleven opportunities and six of them never reached a proposal; the weighted number was never worth much on its own.

What was decided
The pedestal is opened, at no extra cost, and the drawing is reissued.
The wardrobe width goes to one metre twenty, priced as an option rather than a change.
The lobby desk tone is confirmed in a sample in June, and the price moves if the tone changes.
A written programme goes out within a week with the new dates and the new line items.

The twenty-minute soak test
The soak test is not a formality. The lights run at full, the blinds close, and the room is left alone. Two things only show up in that window: a sensor that has drifted and a power supply that is close to its limit. If the room survives twenty minutes with the blinds closed, it will survive a normal evening.

answer: Au maximum, 25 jours consécutifs de congé peuvent être pris par an [1].
sources:
Annual leave
Everyone has twenty-eight days of paid annual leave a year, plus the public holidays between Christmas and New Year, which are not counted. Nobody is expected to take more than twenty-eight days and nobody is asked to explain why they took fewer.
Annual leave must be booked in the people system before the first day of the requested month, and no more than twenty-five consecutive days…

Ce que nous avons appris
Les délais exprimés en semaines rassurent, les délais exprimés en mois inquiètent.
Les projets avec un maître d'ouvrage public ont des cycles d'achat longs et écrits.
Un devis sans exclusions est un devis qui se retourne contre nous à la pose.

Ce que nous avons refusé
Le client voulait un calendrier de dix-huit mois sans marge. L'atelier ne peut pas s'engager sur un calendrier serré sans des conditions de production plus dures, et nous l'avons dit clairement. Nous avons proposé un premier lot en douze mois et un second lot conditionné à la vérification du sol, ce qui a été accepté.

Carry-over
Up to five unused days may be carried into the following year and must be taken before the end of March. Beyond five days, the days are lost, and nobody is asked to justify a lost day.

Booking rules
A request is confirmed by the team leader within five working days.
A booking covering more than ten days is confirmed by the people team as well.
The workshop closes for two weeks in July and two weeks in December. The leave taken in those weeks is the leave taken first.
Public holidays are not deducted from the twenty-eight days.

Les décisions

Le client envoie la liste des pièces par établissement avant la fin du mois.
Nous envoyons un premier chiffrage par établissement, et non un prix global.
Le client vérifiera la solidité du sol avant que nous déposions une offre ferme.

Who approves what
Two signatures are needed above twelve per cent and both of them are in the workshop, not in the sales team. The workshop manager signs because the discount is paid from the material margin, and that margin is set by what the workshop can buy and how quickly it can buy it. A discount agreed without that signature is a discount the workshop pays for.

Les exclusions, pourquoi elles comptent
Sur un marché où le client compare trois offres dans un tableur, une exclusion mal écrite coûte plus cher qu'une remise. Un client qui découvre une exclusion à la pose ne revient pas, et il le raconte. Nous écrivons donc les exclusions avant la première réunion, avec les montants, et nous les envoyons avec le devis plutôt qu'après.

answer: European oak, quarter-sawn where the board allows it [2].
sources:
What it is
The Halden is a solid oak conference table with a steel frame and a cable tray. It is designed for eight to sixteen people and for rooms where the table is the centre of the argument, which is most of them.
Table top NW-HALDEN-03 is a solid oak slab, forty-two millimetres thick, finished with hardwax oil.

The timber
The top is solid oak, and the family is kept to one timber so the drawing set does not multiply.
Timber: European oak, quarter-sawn where the board allows it.
Board width: minimum one hundred and eighty millimetres across the full length.
Moisture content at delivery: between eight and ten per cent.
Movement: the frame is fixed to the top through a slot, so the top can breathe.

Conference table family
The Halden table was designed in 2021 and is still our most requested single piece. The decision was to keep the top in solid oak and to stop offering the stained ash version, which accounted for nine per cent of production and most of the complaints.
The table top is built as one slab for lengths up to three metres and in two parts beyond that. The two-part version needs …

What we tell clients
The table is delivered in two parts for lengths above two point eight metres and needs two people to move.
It must stand on a level floor; the levelling feet cover twenty millimetres.
The top is not a work surface for hot pans, and the oil finish marks easily at first.
Spares for the cable tray lids are available for ten years.

Decisions
The stained ash table version leaves the range at the end of the year.
The Rive Nord shelving system enters the range with two plinth heights only.
The Halden top thickness stays at forty-two millimetres.
No new product is announced before the September review.

answer: The Vesper frame is made from kiln-dried beech [2].
sources:
What it is
The Vesper is a modular sofa for hotel lobbies, reception areas and office landings. It is built from modules that clip into a hidden rail, so a run can be extended, shortened or rearranged on site without a carpenter.
The NW-VESPER-12 configuration seats four and is built from six modules, two of which are corner pieces.

Inside
Frame: kiln-dried beech, corner blocks screwed and glued.
Suspension: webbing and a foam layer, no springs, because springs fail loudly.
Cushions: foam wrapped in a down-and-feather outer, removable for cleaning.
Back cushions: filled separately, so the seat depth does not change with use.
The frame is screwed from below and stays visible under the cover.

Cover and fabric
The cover is removable, washable at thirty degrees and replaceable. The contract fabrics are a contract wool, a heavy plain weave and a coated option for clinics. Colours are held for ten years, which means the fabric is ordered in small quantities and stored.

The frame and the tray
The frame is powder-coated steel, black or a warm grey, with levelling feet that take out the difference between an old floor and a new one. The cable tray runs the length of the table under the middle, on the spine, with two access lids.

What it is
The Marlow is a height-adjustable desk with a single column per side, a frame that lifts one hundred and thirty kilograms and a worktop that is either a compact laminate or solid oak. It is sold to offices and to clinics, where the worktop has to survive a sink.

Height at the seat: forty-three centimetres.

What it is
The Brindle is a lounge chair for hotel lobbies, waiting areas and the corner of a boardroom. It is a bent ply shell on a turned leg frame, upholstered in one piece, and it is meant to be sat in for an hour, not five minutes.
The NW-BRINDLE-08 shell comes in four upholstery options: wool bouclé, saddle leather, recycled felt and a fire-resistant plain weave.

Caractéristiques générales
Hauteur utile : cinq niveaux, réglables de trois centimètres chacun.
Profondeur : quarante centimètres, quarante-six pour la version archives.
Finition : chant scellé sur les quatre faces, finition mate.
Socle : réglable de quatre à douze centimètres, pour les sols à forte variation d'humidité.
Le socle réglable est la raison d'être du produit. Dans une réserve d'archiv…

Options
A higher seat, four centimetres, for older users.
A loose seat cushion in a second colour.
A swivel base instead of the four legs.
A blanket and an integrated reading light, as a hotel option.

Le socle réglable en pratique
Le réglage du socle se fait au montage, avec une clé de treize millimètres, et il absorbe une pente de trois centimètres sur toute la longueur. Pour une réserve d'archives, nous recommandons un relevé de planéité fait par la maîtrise d'ouvrage avant la commande, parce que la variation d'humidité déplace le plancher plus vite que le mobilier.
